basic_info.description: Tucked away just two blocks from the vibrant restaurants and shops of 18th Street, this stunning 2BD/2BA garden-level home offers a rare blend of tranquility and convenience. Set in one of San Francisco's sunniest microclimates, it feels worlds away from the city's hustle yet everything you need is right outside your door. Reimagined and fully renovated down to the studs in 2015, the home features modern systems and designer finishes throughout. The open living and dining area flows seamlessly to a private east-facing deck and lush deeded garden your own secluded oasis bathed in southern sunlight. Two sets of French doors create the ideal indoor-outdoor lifestyle rarely found in city living. The chef's kitchen impresses with stainless steel appliances, custom matte lacquer and mahogany cabinetry, and elegant Carrara marble counters. Bathrooms boast spa-like details, including oversized marble tile in the guest bath and a luxurious walk-in shower with slab marble walls in the primary suite. Radiant heated polished concrete floors run throughout, blending comfort and style. One-car parking completes the package. Perfect for entertaining or quiet retreat, this home is your private escape with the city's best weather right outside.
